id: bigtech:amazon is complaining about nyc council on shipping labels t:2026-11-21T21:59:31.000Z
title: Amazon is complaining about NYC Council on shipping labels, too
author: Terrence O’Brien
summary_long: Amazon is leaving no venue unexplored in its fight against the New York City Council and the Delivery Protection Act. The company is now putting labels on shipments claiming that the Council could add up to $5 to any Amazon order. The Delivery Protection Act would effectively ban the sort of third-party arrangements Amazon currently uses to deliver many packages, including small companies and independent contractors. Last-mile delivery firms operating warehouses would need to be licensed by the city and directly employ their workers. Source: www.theverge.com. Date: 2026-11-21. id: bigtech:the fbi and usda were reportedly hacked:2026-11-21T17:42:27.000Z
title: The FBI and USDA were reportedly hacked
author: Terrence O’Brien
summary_long: Friday, it was reported that both the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the FBI were hacked. In reporting on the FBI hack, CNN noted that this is the second such attack on the agency in the last few months, this time targeting the National Crime Information Center (NCIC), which federal, state, and local law enforcement use to share information, including warrants and missing persons. President Donald Trump later confirmed the hack in an interview with Fox News. NBC first reported the USDA hack on Friday. Source: www.theverge.com. Date: 2026-11-21.
